newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary puts 1996 wheat harvest at 3,924,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Hungary puts 1996 wheat harvest at 3,924,000 T.

text.p: Hungary harvested 3.924 million tonnes of wheat on 1.193 million hectares in 1996, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
The outturn showed a 14.8 percent decline on last year and a 36.9 percent fall on the average between 1986 and 1990, the KSH said.
Average per hectare yield, at 3,290 kilos, was 21.1 percent below last year's average and was 32.6 percent below the 1986-1990 average, it said.
The KSH blamed last year's unfavourable weather and the financial difficulties of agricultural entrepreneurs for the fall in output.

The KSH said grain output excluding maize was 5.31 million tonnes in 1996, down from 6.53 million in 1995 -- a 18.7 percent decline year-on-year and a fall of 30.7 percent on the average for 1986-1990.
